svg.aria-label: A terminal. After Claude's answer, a pixel-art cat appears above the prompt, walks its shelf and knocks the mug off. Beside it: Don't delegate your reasoning. Or you'll get a mug.

g.text: Added a token bucket in front of /export.
60 requests a minute per key. Tests pass.
You can ask. The cat decides.
You pick what goes on the shelf.
